OBTP conversion, 2026-09-23: extracted saved render meshes using rhino3dm; applied the source instance's Z reflection; reversed triangle winding; split quads into triangles; merged vertices sharing coordinates rounded to six decimal places in millimetres. Original seven Brep IDs retained. No CAD reshaping, joint invention, parametric resizing or remeshing. Labels, descriptive part names, colours and explosion vectors are OBTP display additions. Colours are illustrative. Explosion is not an assembly instruction.

The model is a display derivative, not CNC output or engineering validation. The W-S CNC folder says offsets and dog-bones are pre-applied. Do not add allowances or generate cutting geometry from this web mesh. P01–P07 have not been mapped to CNC identifiers. The CAD file remains authoritative.

This notice applies to the imported and derived geometry, and does not relicense unrelated application code.
